description: Multi-bot roster + CAS failover. scheduled_publish is the nominal wall-clock target; scheduled_cron / bots[].platform_cron fire earlier by scheduler_lag_compensation_minutes because the host often wakes agents ~15–20 minutes late. claim_window_early_skew_minutes allows claim shortly before start; min_remaining_minutes_to_start_full_publish gates late wakes that still have enough time.

bots.duties: Platform cron is 05:10 HKT to absorb ~15–20min wake lag; nominal publish 05:30. On wake: success guard; if missing and remaining time until claim_window_end >= min_remaining_minutes_to_start_full_publish (25), CAS claim and full publish. Interest-notes sync cron 04:45.
At 06:20 HKT (platform cron may fire slightly early; use early_skew), failover check; CAS claim if today missing. Window 06:20–06:50.

last_success.note: Maintainer-authorized delayed recovery publish after morning late wake and Neon no takeover; digest, figures, index, seen-papers and this publish event are recorded in one commit; resolve the publishing commit from the history of digests/2026-09-18.md.
